mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and ototoxic; tobramycin is an aminoglycoside with inherent renal and auditory toxicity, while fluoroquinolones can potentiate these effects and impair aminoglycoside clearance.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and auditory function regularly; adjust tobramycin dosing based on creatinine clearance; consider alternative agents if possible; ensure adequate hydration.
